newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola FEMSA starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola FEMSA starts.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Lucrecia Tam on Tuesday started coverage of Mexican bottler Coca-Cola FEMSA SA with a rating of buy.
-- "Our estimates ... point to an average 27 percent growth in operating cash flow and 20 percent in earnings," Tam wrote in an analysis.
-- "Current stock price does not reflect the company's new earnings estimates, and it is looking attractive relative to its peers.
-- "Our 12-month price target is $40 per ADR (American Depositary Receipt), providing a 24 percent upside."
-- The company's ADRs closed at 32-3/8 on Monday.
